power_w.description: Estimated LED power of the last frame.

power_limited.description: The power limit reduced the brightness of the last frame.

frames_rx.description: Valid UDP color frames received since boot.

last_frame_ms.description: Time since the last valid UDP frame; -1 if none was received yet.

config_rev.description: Settings revision: changes after every saved settings change (/save/*), starts at a random value at boot; compare for equality only — any difference means re-read GET /config.

reset_reason.description: Why the board last started (esp_reset_reason): poweron after a power cycle, panic / *_wdt after a crash, sw after a restart by the firmware (e.g. a Wi-Fi link down too long). Missing on older firmware.

wifi_status.description: Station link state (arduino-esp32 wl_status_t): 3 = connected, 5 = connection lost, 6 = disconnected. Missing on older firmware.
